plugin.name: Ponytail Probe
plugin.description: Use when reviewing a software change for correctness, safety, expected load, testing and unnecessary complexity.

intake.goal: Bounded experiment requested by the owner on 2026-11-12: assess the core working policy as always-on session guidance and preserve the selected review procedure on demand. Read both selected files by meaning and record the split. This is a two-file transport/behavior probe, not full Ponytail integration or a change to Marionette. No source hook, mode state, map, band, installer, audit, debt or gain feature is selected. The original release and exact Git objects were retrieved through the GitHub connector; repo_path holds a partial object database with matching upstream commit/tree/blob hashes.
